next.reason: 1985 format 2 (REPLACE OFF) discontinues any replacement in effect. 2023: §2023:7.2.4.4 GR7 'A format 2 REPLACE statement without the LAST phrase cancels the active REPLACE statement and cancels all REPLACE statements in the queue'; §2023:7.2.4.4 GR6 'A format 2 REPLACE statement has no effect' when none is active; canceled means 'removed from use for replace processing for the remainder of the compilation group' (§2023:7.2.4.4 GR4). REPLACE LAST OFF is new syntax and only 2023's ALSO fills the queue, so a 1985 REPLACE OFF means the same.
